avis.titre: Gentle everyday cleanser that feels soothing on th
avis.texte: The Gentle Skin Cleanser has been really good for everyday skincare because it cleans the skin without making it feel dry or irritated afterward. The formula feels very mild and soothing, which makes it great for sensitive skin or days when my skin feels extra dry. I like that it removes dirt, oil, and light makeup while still leaving the skin soft and comfortable instead of tight. The texture is smooth and non-foaming, and it works well both in the morning and at night. It's especially helpful during colder weather or when using stronger skincare products that can dry out the skin. Another thing I appreciate is that it's fragrance-free and gentle enough for daily use. One thing to know before buying is that people who prefer a deep foamy cleanse may find the texture lighter than expected. Overall, it's a simple and reliable cleanser that works really well for maintaining soft, calm, and healthy-looking skin.

avis.texte: This is a very gentle cleanser that works well for sensitive and dry skin. It has a light creamy texture and almost no strong scent, which makes it comfortable to use every day. I've used a lot of different cleansers over the years and this Cetaphil Gentle Skin Cleanser is one of those products that seems like its been around forever, but for a reason. It's extremely simple, but sometimes that is exactly what your skin needs. I originally tried it during a period when my skin barrier was super irritated and pretty reactive to nearly everything I was putting on my face. Most cleaners, even the ones that are for sensitive skin, left my skin feeling tight afterwards. This one didn't! The texture is more of a creamy liquid rather than a foaming cleanser, which surprised me because I'm used to foaming gel formulas. It doesn't lather at all, but that's the point. This cleanser will leave your skin feeling clean but still comfortable. İ appreciate that it's fragrance free and very minimal in terms of irritation potential. When my skin is acting up, i tend to strip my routine back to the basics. And this is a product i know i can rely on without worrying that it will trigger redness or breakouts. İts also super versatile because you can use it in the morning or at night. Overall, this is a dependable and gentle option that works well for sensitive and/pr dry skin. Sometimes the simplest formulas end up being the ones you keep coming back to :)

avis.titre: You RUINED the best facial cleanser ever made!
avis.texte: The opposite of Gentle!!!! I've been using Cetaphil cleanser for 40 years!!!! Since my dermatologist recommended when I was 16 after a reaction to soap. Stop listening to the stupidity of people trying to erase ingredients. They can choose to not buy the product. But for those of us who need the Original formula to have our skin survive and who supported you Cetaphil, this is what you do to your loyal customers?! This new formula is not made for dry or sensitive skin. It's like pouring acid on it. The burning and pain is insane! I'm outraged. I just bought several bottles I'll have to through away. But the worst part is I have nothing safe for cleaning my face now. I have recommended the original product to tons of people over the past 40 yrs. More than any other product I've used. So many companies are ruining their products. I was so thankful and prayed you all never would. Cetaphil original formula gentle cleanser for sensitive skin was the only product in my life I'd choose to stay the same if I had one choice. So furious and so disappointed. What a betrayal of your company and name to us. Offer a new product with this new formula. But bring back the ORIGINAL formula for those who stayed with you for decades so we can continue to buy it!
